Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Math Class¶

class Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Math(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Math commands are used to set the operations between the waveforms of multiple channels.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

The Math class is used to set the operations between the waveforms of multiple channels.

Parameters:

  • instrument (pyvisa.Resource) – The instrument to control.

  • data_handler (DataHandler) – The data handler for processing data.
